summary: OceanFirst Financial Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of Flushing Financial Corporation via a two-step merger. Under the merger agreement, each share of Flushing common stock was converted into 0.85 shares of OceanFirst common stock (exchange ratio, no cash price per share stated). The transaction closed on June 1, 2026. No board recommendation, advisors, or premium percentage are mentioned in this summary filing. A subsequent bank merger of Flushing Bank into OceanFirst Bank is also planned. The structure is an all-stock acquisition. Watch for integration progress and any post-closing operational updates as the risk-arb angle is largely resolved with closing.
